senses.gloss:
Gautamī-putra (IE 2-8), metronymic meaning^1 ‘the son of a lady born in a family belonging to the Gautama gotra’. Such metronymics refer to the absence of gotr-āntara (i. e. the change of the bride's paternal gotra to that of her husband at the time of marriage) in a popular form of ancient Indian marriage.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
